title: Every report .md has a .pdf: registry rule, writers, checker, pack rebuild (REQ-0093)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 registry: every kind with md lists pdf
AC2 pack writes pdf beside every md
AC3 checker fails on md without pdf and pdf without md
AC5 pack rebuilt at $0, counts md=pdf

design.summary: registry pdf_with_md flag + ext lists (answer-sheet, score-summary gain pdf); build_pack renders pdf beside every md via md_to_pdf, missing renderer is a clear failure; checker fails on md without pdf and pdf without md; INDEX lists pdfs; legacy folders untouched; rebuild reports/dgnl2026 to 35 files, md 10 = pdf 10

implementation.summary: registry pdf_with_md + pdf in answer-sheet and score-summary; build_pack renders pdf beside every md, missing renderer is a clear error, stale pdf removed; checker fails on md without pdf and pdf without md; pack rebuilt md 10 = pdf 10, 62 checks 0 failed, 113/120

unit_test.result: test_report_kinds 54 OK (11 new 86 tests, 9 fail on previous code); full suite 1701 run, only the 4 known pre-existing failures

security.result: pairing rule is read from the registry; paths built by registry pattern; pdf renderer invoked without shell by existing md_to_pdf; no AI calls

verification.command: python3 -I tools/check_report_pack.py reports/dgnl2026 ... --expect-correct 113; unit-full; verifier recount; pdftotext on solution-report and answer-sheet pdfs
verification.result: pack 10 md + 10 pdf (+INDEX.md), no orphan either way; checker 62 checks 0 failed, 113/120; legacy folders untouched (newest file dates before this task); full suite 1701 run, only the 4 known pre-existing failures; verifier AC1-AC6 PASS

quality.reason: pack recounted independently by the verifier and by the checker; pdf content read with pdftotext

user_notes.note: each .md kind has a .pdf; validate so never missed; rebuild and tell
